task_design.title: Disenar una cola FIFO persistente con estados pending, running, completed y failed
task_design.scope_boundary: Diseno acotado; no modifica runtime/project_state.json, runtime/task_queue.json, runtime/task_history.jsonl, runtime/failures.jsonl, checkpoints, directives ni logs internos del control plane.

storage_contract.worker_access: read-only unless a future task explicitly owns queue implementation
storage_contract.write_strategy: atomic temp file write followed by fsync and rename
storage_contract.concurrency_guard: single writer lock around load-modify-save operations

fifo_semantics.enqueue: append a new task with status=pending at the tail of the queue
fifo_semantics.claim_next: select the first pending task whose dependencies are completed and atomically transition it to running
fifo_semantics.completion: transition running to completed only after declared validations pass and expected evidence exists on disk
fifo_semantics.failure: transition running to failed when timeout, validation failure, or exhausted retries are recorded
fifo_semantics.retry: retry is attached to the failed task record; it increments attempts and returns the task to pending only when attempts < max_retries
fifo_semantics.dependency_rule: a pending task is claimable only when every dependency id has status=completed

runtime_rules.session_shape: a session contains multiple tasks; each task launches its own worker
runtime_rules.timeouts: timeout_seconds is evaluated per task, not per session
runtime_rules.termination: worker terminate is attempted first; kill is required if terminate does not close the process
runtime_rules.progress: progress is counted only from disk evidence and persisted validation history

verification_plan: schema validation for every queued task
unit test: enqueue preserves FIFO order
unit test: claim_next skips blocked dependencies
unit test: running task timeout produces failed with last_error
unit test: retry returns failed task to pending only below max_retries
integration test: validation_passed is required before completed

main_risks: concurrent writers corrupting the JSON queue
implicit smoke detection changing runtime behavior
complexity_assessment.recommended_next_task: Implementar orchestrator/task_queue.py con atomic writes, schema checks y pruebas FIFO enfocadas.
